intro.role: Frontend engineer · Svelte and TypeScript · Kraków
intro.pitch: I design, build and run complete products. Websites since 1999, Svelte for over five years.
intro.point: Point at a product to see which packages it uses.
work.heading: Products
work.zaur.what: A private communications suite on one account: mail, calendar, video calls and music, on servers I set up and run.
work.zaur.built.0: A mail client over JMAP on SvelteKit 3 and remote functions, started on the pre-release: installable and offline-capable, with push notifications, calendar, contacts, files, rich compose and several accounts.
work.zaur.built.1: Its own sign-in. Mail is the OpenID Connect provider for Music, Photos and Bartube, and a sign-up portal creates real mailboxes through the Stalwart admin API.
work.zaur.built.2: The servers behind it: Stalwart mail on a VPS run through Dokploy, restic backups to a second machine, errors and traces in a self-hosted Traceway.
work.zaur.proof.0.v: 50 test files across the client and its shared packages; Playwright for sign-up
work.zaur.proof.2.v: GitHub Actions deploys; agent conventions in AGENTS.md
work.zaur.proof.3.v: Mail sorted by an LLM into a fixed set of labels, with a confidence floor, a timeout and a headers-only privacy mode
demo.mail-demo.name: Zaur Mail demo
demo.mail-demo.note: The real client over a sample mailbox; nothing is sent, and it resets every 30 minutes.
demo.signup.name: Zaur sign-up
demo.signup.note: The real sign-up: an account made here is a working mailbox.
work.szkolyjogi.what: The directory of yoga and pilates schools in Poland: class schedules, pass prices, reviews and online sign-up.
work.szkolyjogi.built.0: The public directory in Polish, English and Ukrainian, with schedules, prices, reviews and booking.
work.szkolyjogi.built.1: A separate panel app for schools: passes, recurring classes, refund rules, VAT split and staff roles.
work.szkolyjogi.built.2: A Python scraper that reads school websites, price lists and timetable images with LLMs. Answers are forced into schemas, the model returns null rather than guessing, monthly prices are computed in code, and a read that would shrink a stored schedule below 40% keeps the old classes.
work.szkolyjogi.built.3: A database trigger stops the scraper overwriting anything a school edited itself. CI builds both apps as images and deploys them.
work.szkolyjogi.proof.1.v: Benchmarked before use; one was dropped for inventing 15 classes on an empty page
work.szkolyjogi.proof.2.v: Home-page layout shift cut from 0.11 to 0.00 with metric-matched font fallbacks
work.szkolyjogi.proof.3.v: SvelteKit, Svelte 5, Drizzle, Postgres, Better Auth
work.thebest.what: A tour marketplace for Cracow: local guides, live availability and online booking.
work.thebest.built.0: Tour pages with live availability, time slots, pricing and cancellation policies, all from svelte-scheduler.
work.thebest.built.1: Checkout on Stripe Connect, still in test mode while the business side is set up.
work.thebest.built.2: English and Polish, deployed on Railway.
work.thebest.proof.1.v: A repeated Stripe webhook is ignored once the booking is paid
work.kino.what: What plays in Polish cinemas today, hour by hour, with the small studio, culture-centre and film-club cinemas the big apps miss.
work.kino.proof.0.v: 230 cinemas in 174 towns, crawled every 6 hours
work.kino.proof.1.v: 12 ticketing-site readers that keep the last good data on an empty read. When one site blocked the server, I switched source and measured the cost: 6% of films missed, none wrong
work.kino.proof.2.v: Town pages, a page per film, a panel where cinemas fix their own facts
work.kompi.what: One map of the places in Poland that take back e-waste, batteries and bulbs, filtered by what they accept and how.
work.kompi.proof.0.v: 30,036 collection points in 1,951 cities, scraped by a Python crawler
work.kompi.proof.1.v: MapLibre, address search, nearest points from your location
work.festivals.what: A worldwide directory of friendly, open-minded festivals: ceremony and embodiment gatherings next to boutique music and arts festivals.
work.festivals.proof.1.v: A fact read by an LLM is kept only if its quote is on the fetched page; nothing publishes without approval

clients.heading: Clients
clients.lede: An online shop and five websites for businesses: designed, built and kept running.
site.fixtar.desc: An online shop for power tools that I built and run for a client: catalogue, checkout, payments and order handling.
site.fixtar.specs.1.v: PayU, Przelewy24; a payment marks the order paid once, and only that request pushes it to BaseLinker and sends the email
site.fixtar.specs.2.v: Built to the client’s technical SEO spec: Product and Offer schema, five split sitemaps, canonical and noindex rules
site.fixtar.specs.3.v: Google Shopping feed generated from the same data as the schema
site.pikastro.desc: A colourful interior design studio in Kraków, with a custom CMS: the owner edits text and photos right on the live page.
site.pikastro.specs.0.v: Custom, click-to-edit on the page, with edit history
site.wibroakustyka.desc: Product site for the Graal vibroacoustic wellness chair.
site.wibroakustyka.specs.0.v: What an acoustic chair is and how vibroacoustics works
site.wibroakustyka.specs.1.v: News and the Health & Longevity Summit 2026
site.tutitutu.desc: Image-first portfolio for an interior architecture studio founded in 1997, which edits its own site.
site.tutitutu.specs.0.v: Built on Michael Aufreiter’s Editable Website and extended by hand before AI: realisations with drag-and-drop ordering and image cropping
site.intertech.desc: Equipment catalogue and industry news for the Polish representative of Picarro and UGT.
site.intertech.specs.0.v: Emissions monitoring and reduction, leak detection, pipe replacement
site.intertech.specs.1.v: CRDS spectroscopy, lysimeters, ecotrons, plant sensors
site.intertech.specs.2.v: My first hand-written Svelte site; rebuilt on Svelte 5 in 2025
site.polaczenie.desc: Acupuncture clinic in Kraków offering treatments that complement conventional care.
site.polaczenie.specs.0.v: One page, in Polish and English
site.radiobartek.desc: A 24/7 internet radio station with an AI DJ who talks between the tracks in a clone of my voice.
site.radiobartek.specs.0.v: Open-source SUB/WAVE with my own skins and patches; the sky is zaur-world through its React adapter
site.radiobartek.specs.1.v: A Python bridge to Fish Audio speech that clones a voice from a short clip
site.radiobartek.specs.2.v: About 35 new tracks a day, picked from ListenBrainz recommendations
site.kurcz.desc: Everything about muscle cramps: causes, first aid and prevention, as fast static pages.
site.kurcz.specs.0.v: Astro, no JavaScript on article pages
site.kruk.desc: Five mini-apps live on one site: a drawing board, a kanban, pixel art, friends and a property scraper.
site.kruk.specs.2.v: An experiment with Phoenix LiveView; the Elixir is written by Claude Code
packages.heading: Packages
packages.lede: The building blocks my products share, published on npm under @nomideusz.
packages.i18n.hint: Every word on this page is a key in a flat JSON catalog.
packages.i18n.hintOn: Everything but this line now shows its key from the flat JSON catalog.
packages.geometrize.hint: Every screenshot on this page paints first as triangles fitted at build time, then opens into the picture.
packages.world.hint: This sky is the package, drawn live for Kraków: real sun, weather and stars. It is the sky of Radio Bartek, my 24/7 station whose AI DJ talks between the tracks in a clone of my voice.
pkg.zaur-world: A living ambient sky: real sun times, weather, true star positions, eclipses, and a pixel dinosaur who lives in it. Zero dependencies.
pkg.svelte-calendar: A themeable Svelte 5 calendar: day, week, scrolling-week and month views, agenda lists, touch-first mobile layouts, drag-and-drop, timezones, a headless API and an embeddable web component.
pkg.svelte-search: Full-text search for Svelte 5: FTS5, fuzzy matching, geo proximity, autocomplete, Polish locale.
pkg.svelte-i18n: Lightweight i18n for Svelte 5: runes-based locale state, flat JSON messages, URL-locale routing. This page is translated with it.
pkg.svelte-geometrize: Geometric image placeholders: triangles resolve into the real photo as it loads.
pkg.svelte-qr: Zero-dependency QR codes for Svelte 5: a pure TypeScript encoder with SVG output.
pkg.svelte-media: Image upload, processing, and S3-compatible storage for Svelte 5 apps.
pkg.svelte-scheduler: Booking and scheduling logic for Svelte 5: tour slots, pricing, cancellation policies.
pkg.svelte-payments: Provider-agnostic payments for booking apps: a Mollie server adapter and a Stripe Connect UI.
pkg.svelte-notify: Email notification templates for booking apps.
